verdict.rationale: Unreal ships genuine background-automation tooling — Python editor scripting, the Unreal Automation Tool for unattended test/build runs, command-line driven cook/build pipelines, and a Remote Control API/web server for external, unattended control — which could be wired into scheduled or agent-triggered pipelines. However, none of this is framed as AI-agent-native automation; there's no evidence of AI agents autonomously invoking these systems or of persistent background 'AI automations' as opposed to traditional build/test/editor scripting. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent orchestration hooks, evidence of autonomous decision-making rather than scripted/triggered jobs, and independent confirmation of AI-driven background automation in practice.
